content.comment_body: Hello, After completing earlier projects with [product_name] and [product_name], I’ve begun a new project using [product_name] [version_no] and new [product_name] software. However, I can't get the [product_name] interface screen to appear (even the [product_name] Operator Display is missing). I have tried many access control settings; now I can see the login screen, but there’s no feedback when attempting to log in—not even an incorrect password message. The [version_no] introduces new settings. Could someone outline the correct procedure to view a customized page? [article_no], FS:1 FW [version_no]

It’s challenging to evaluate from a distance. Is there a FAT32-formatted microSD card in the [product_name]? Did you transfer the [product_name] project to the card? Have you enabled web server access in access control? Did you allow [product_name] and [product_name] access in the access control? Have you applied and confirmed all required approvals?

Thanks for the reply. I originally set up the project with [product_name] [version_no], and the SD card/project worked then. Transferring the project to [version_no] didn’t work, so I recreated it in [version_no]. The project is present on the SD card and expected to be referenced in access control; I've tested multiple settings. The login screen was problematic initially, but current settings have advanced progress and the [product_name] responds.
Sorry, I’m unable to assist in this situation. You might want to initiate a support request.

Hello, I’m facing the same problems. Has any solution been identified? Very interested to know. Thanks.
Have you reviewed all of these steps? If yes and the issue persists, consider submitting a support request.

Hello, perhaps I am mistaken, but I encountered a similar issue previously. What is the resolution setting for your [product_name] project, and what is the display resolution where you’re having trouble? If the [product_name] resolution is much higher than your display’s, the scrollbar might be out of the visible range. If that’s true, match the [product_name] resolution to your display and this should resolve the problem. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing problems accessing and interacting with the web interface of [product_name] [version_no], especially with login functionality and viewing customized content after migrating from older versions. Lack of login feedback is causing confusion and repeated troubleshooting. There are usability concerns related to access control configuration, SD card handling, and display compatibility that are affecting functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates a smooth project migration between [product_name] versions, effective error messaging when login attempts fail, and reliable access to customized web pages following proper setup.
